sections.title: Instrument Setup
sections.summary: Hold the violin and bow safely with balanced posture.
sections.text: Instrument setup establishes a safe, balanced playing posture.

sections.title: Bow Hold
sections.summary: Shape the right hand around the bow with flexible fingers.
sections.text: Prerequisites: instrument-setup. The bow hold uses flexible fingers and a relaxed thumb.

sections.title: Open-String Bow
sections.summary: Draw a straight, steady bow across an open string.
sections.text: Prerequisites: bow-hold. Open-string bowing develops a straight, steady sound.

sections.title: First-Position Notes
sections.summary: Place first-position fingers accurately on the fingerboard.
sections.text: Prerequisites: instrument-setup. First-position notes require accurate finger placement.

sections.title: Simple Violin Melody
sections.summary: Combine bow control, fingering, and pitch in a short melody.
sections.text: Prerequisites: open-string-bow, first-position-notes. A simple violin melody combines bow control and fingering.
